payload.summary: Vendor-review remediation. Codex (single vendor, adjudicated valid by the orchestrator) found that validate_binding still accepted an empty reviewers list or reviewers without identity; the binding shape check now requires named reviewers with an agent_id key that match a successful lane, and a same-vendor reviewer with an unknown agent id fails independence. antigravity returned no findings; grok timed out and pi returned unparseable output.
completed_work: [high] correctness: empty/anonymous binding reviewers accepted (codex vendor review)

decisions.title: Adjudicate the lone codex high finding as valid
decisions.rationale: A tampered stored binding with reviewers=[] passed the predicate because independence had nothing to check.
